title: understudy.benchmark.v1
description: The canonical benchmark manifest: a task taxonomy plus seeded task instances bound to one executable environment form and one verifier contract. Covers benchmarks derived from a user's own traces, benchmarks imported from external formats (verifiers Environments Hub, Harbor task dirs, AutomationBench, inspect_ai, HF datasets), and hand-authored ones — all first-class in the same shape. The manifest is the durable Understudy-owned artifact; the executable form it points at (a verifiers-v1 environment package) is compiled from it and may be re-targeted when the runtime library moves. Results are NOT stored here: each executed root-to-leaf trace branch projects to one understudy.eval_result.v1 row carrying benchmark_id/category_id/trace_ref as extension fields, and the traces.jsonl DAG is retained as drill-down evidence. Most fields are nullable so a manifest can be started thin (e.g. at import time) and enriched. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand. This manifest is a local artifact — it must carry references, never inline traces, prompts, gold contents, or secrets.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this manifest shape.

benchmark_id.description: Stable identifier for this benchmark across runs, viewers, and handoffs.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the viewer.

description.description: What the benchmark measures and where it came from.

origin.description: How this benchmark came to exist. derived-from-traces = induced from the user's own captured workload; imported = converted from an external benchmark format; authored = written by hand.

source_refs.description: Paths or ids of the local evidence this benchmark is grounded in (ingest artifacts, workload cards, trace corpus ids). References only — never inline contents.

format.description: External format the benchmark was converted from.

ref.description: External identifier, e.g. 'terminal-bench@2.1', an Environments Hub slug, or a dataset repo id.

version.description: Pinned upstream version or commit of the imported benchmark.

license.description: Upstream license (SPDX id where known). Null means unverified — the viewer should surface this.

imported_from.description: Present iff origin is 'imported'. Null for derived/authored benchmarks.

provenance.description: Where the benchmark came from, for auditability and for the viewer's evidence warnings.

difficulty.description: Coarse difficulty tier for the category.

tool_signature.description: Tool names characterizing the trace cluster this category was induced from.

source_trace_ids.description: References to the traces the cluster was induced from. References only.

derived_from.description: How the category was induced from traces. Null for imported/authored categories.

taxonomy.description: Named task categories. Scores are reported per category in the viewer.

category_id.description: Must match a taxonomy entry's category_id.

seed.description: Seed for the task's initial environment state. Null when the task is not seeded.

genesis.description: replayed = a captured real task instance; synthesized = generated fresh from a category's generator; imported = converted from the external source.

generator_ref.description: Reference to the prompt/program that synthesized the task. Required in spirit when genesis is 'synthesized' so synthesis is reproducible.

split.description: Frozen split membership. 'none' means the benchmark has no split contract for this task.

kind.description: final-state = assertions over the environment's end state; rubric = judged criteria; reference = a gold answer/artifact.

ref.description: Reference to the gold artifact. Never inline gold contents here.

gold.description: What correct looks like for this task. Null means the task is unscored (rows project as status=unscored).

tasks.description: The task instances. Task inputs, fixtures, and gold contents live in the environment package — this list is the index.

format.description: Executable form. verifiers.v1 is the compile target; verifiers.v0 admits envs still on the frozen v0 API of the pinned library (e.g. vf-eval scaffolds) so a manifest never has to misstate its executable form. The enum widens only if the compile target changes.

package_ref.description: Path or pip reference to the environment package exposing load_environment().

package_sha256.description: Content hash of the compiled package, so manifest/package drift is detectable.

tool_surface.description: Tool names the environment exposes to the policy.

verifiers_version_pin.description: Exact verifiers library pin the package was compiled against, e.g. '==0.2.0'. The single place the upstream pin lives.

environment.description: The one executable form this benchmark compiles to.

strict_metric.description: Name of the binary/gate metric (e.g. task_completed_correctly). Projects to the eval row's primary score.

dense_metric.description: Name of the partial-credit metric, if any. Projects into the eval row's subscores.

replayable.description: True iff scoring recomputes offline from traces.jsonl alone (trace-only handlers and judges). False means re-scoring requires live environment state. Null means not yet determined.

verifier.description: The scoring contract. When kind is final-state and replayable is true, the same verifier doubles as an RL reward.

boundary.description: The train/dev/holdout boundary in force (e.g. 'seed-7: train 18 / dev 6 / holdout 6').

splits_sha256.description: sha256 of the frozen split contract (matches capture-evidence splits_sha256).

contamination.description: Whether any train/RL pool derived from this benchmark has been verified to exclude frozen dev/holdout rows. Imported public benchmarks start 'unknown' and the viewer must surface that.

splits.description: Split and contamination state, same contract as verifier_handoff.v1. Null means no split discipline exists yet — a visible evidence warning, not a default to hide.

eval_id.description: The frozen capture-evidence eval that remains production ground truth for the workload this benchmark generalizes.

splits_sha256.description: Split hash of the linked eval, so drift between the pair is detectable.

linked_eval.description: The paired production eval. The benchmark is the generalization/training surface; the linked eval is the regression gate. Null (typical for imported public benchmarks) is a visible evidence warning in the viewer.

row_schema.description: Result rows always project to the shared eval-row shape.

trace_artifact.description: Filename of the retained DAG evidence artifact, e.g. 'traces.jsonl'.

branch_projection.description: Human-readable statement of the projection rule, e.g. 'one row per root-to-leaf branch'.

results_contract.description: How runs of this benchmark become rows and evidence.
